# Deprecations

We use the term "deprecation" to refer to the process of retiring a model or endpoint. When we announce that a model or endpoint is being deprecated, it immediately becomes deprecated. All deprecated models and endpoints will also have a shut down date.

## Upcoming deprecations

### 2026-06-11: GPT-4.5 Preview

| Shutdown date | Model / system | Recommended replacement |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Dec 11, 2026 | `gpt-4.5-preview` | `gpt-5.6-sol` |
| Dec 11, 2026 | `gpt-dangling-source` | `gpt-missing-successor` |
